title: Ghosh Healthcare CT Scan Suite
subtitle: Patient-Centred CT Scan Room & Control Room Design
description: A 600 sq.ft. CT scan suite in Gangarampur for Ghosh Healthcare, combining a clinically efficient scan room and control room with a calming, patient-first environment, featuring a floor-to-ceiling beach mural, soft blue wall panelling and a direct viewing window from the control desk.
body:
Designed for Ghosh Healthcare in Gangarampur, this 600 sq.ft. CT scan suite brings together a scan room and its control room in a layout that works as well for patients as it does for clinical staff.

The scan room is planned around the gantry, with clear circulation for staff and stretcher access, a modular ceiling carrying lighting and air diffusers, and smooth, easy-to-clean finishes suited to a diagnostic environment. To ease patient anxiety, a floor-to-ceiling tropical beach mural wraps the walls in the patient's view, softening what is usually a stark clinical space.

The adjoining control room looks directly onto the scanner through a timber-framed viewing window, giving technicians constant visual contact with the patient. A two-person workstation with ergonomic seating, overhead storage and task lighting completes a practical, comfortable workspace.
features.0.title: A Calming Space for Patients
features.0.text: CT scans can be stressful, so the room is designed to put patients at ease. A floor-to-ceiling tropical beach mural wraps the walls in the patient's line of sight, turning a clinical space into a calmer, more open-feeling environment during positioning and scanning.
features.1.title: Clean, Efficient Scan Room Layout
features.1.text: The gantry is centred on the room with clear circulation around the patient couch for staff and stretcher access. Soft blue wall panelling, a modular ceiling with recessed lighting and air diffusers, and easy-to-clean white flooring create a bright, hygienic room that is simple to maintain.
features.2.title: Control Room with Direct Viewing
features.2.text: The adjoining control room has a timber-framed viewing window looking directly onto the scanner, so technicians can watch the patient throughout. A two-person workstation with ergonomic chairs, under-cabinet lighting, overhead storage and an open display niche keeps the workspace organised and comfortable for long shifts.
